_about: Twelve location-bank entries to MERGE into style_lab/research/location_bank.json 'locations' (same schema). go_settings.assign() raises on an unknown location_id, so these must land before settings_rows.csv is applied. Descriptions from a2_build/historical/real_places.md; each place is described by features, never named in the prompt (naming_the_place_helps=false except the Town Hall square).

locations.name: Kaunas — Palace of Justice and Seimas (1925–30)
signature_features: heavy three-storey neoclassical corner block
ground-floor arcade of round arches at the entrance
tall windows, plain cornice, low hipped roof
inside: marble columns with folk-carved capitals; tall skylit hall
locations.prompt_phrase: heavy three-storey neoclassical corner block with a ground-floor arcade of round arches at the entrance, tall windows above, a plain cornice and a low hipped roof
locations.state_1981: Built 1925–28/30 (E. A. Frykas) for the Ministry of Justice and the Supreme Tribunal; Seimas from 1936; Kaunas Philharmonic today. In a free 1981 the Supreme Tribunal (or the Seimas) still sits here.
free_lithuania_1981_adjustments: Latin motto over the arcade is not drawn (no lettering).
State emblem inside may be the Cross of Vytis or the Vytis (rule change 2026-10-17).
unverified_points: arcade count and roof form (visual, from photographs)

locations.name: Kaunas — Central Post Office (1930–32)
signature_features: smooth pale rendered flat-roofed modernist block
very large windows in carved wooden frames
electric clock on the front
inside: tall hall, floor tiled like a woven linen towel, brass-railed counters
locations.prompt_phrase: smooth pale rendered flat-roofed modernist block with very large windows set in carved wooden frames, a round clock on the front, a stepped central bay
locations.state_1981: Built 1930–32 (F. Vizbaras); UNESCO 2023. The main post office of Kaunas in any 1981.

locations.name: Kaunas — Bank of Lithuania (1924–28)
signature_features: monumental pale neoclassical corner building, three storeys, columned entrance
inside: black marble Ionic columns, granite stairs, coffered ceilings
great banking hall under a triangular glass skylight, chandeliers, grey geometric floor tiles
locations.prompt_phrase: monumental pale stone-coloured neoclassical corner building of three storeys with a tall columned entrance and heavy cornice
locations.state_1981: Built 1924–28 (M. Songaila); still the Bank of Lithuania. The central bank of a free Lithuania, or its Kaunas branch.

locations.name: Kaunas — War Museum and Čiurlionis Gallery (1936)
signature_features: long low pale block, classicism meeting early functionalism
tall square carillon bell tower at one end
garden with the Freedom Statue (winged figure on a tall plinth, Zikaras 1928) and an eternal flame
inside: the orange Lituanica hanging in a hall; old cannons; the art wing with Čiurlionis paintings and amber
locations.prompt_phrase: long low pale museum block with a tall square bell tower at one end, a formal garden in front with a winged bronze figure striding on a tall plinth and a small eternal flame
locations.state_1981: Opened 16 Feb 1936 (V. Dubeneckis, K. Reisonas). In a free 1981 the garden statues the Soviets removed in the 1950s still stand, the Freedom Statue included.
exclude_built_after_1981_or_demolished: Soviet-era removals never happened in the counterfactual
free_lithuania_1981_adjustments: Freedom Statue standing (removed 1950s, restored 1989 in reality).

locations.name: Kaunas — Sports Hall (1939)
signature_features: plain monumental box, austere plastered walls, portals with half-columns
inside: four great riveted steel arches carrying a shallow vaulted roof with triangular skylights
wooden stands round a parquet court, hoops on plain backboards
locations.prompt_phrase: inside a great plain hall where four riveted steel arches carry a shallow vaulted roof with triangular skylights over a parquet basketball court ringed by wooden stands
locations.state_1981: Built 1938–39 (A. Rozenbliumas, S. Kudokas) in six months; first hall in Europe built for basketball; venue of the 1939 European championship Lithuania won. Kaunas's main hall in any 1981.
free_lithuania_1981_adjustments: No club lettering; a tricolour only.

locations.name: Kaunas — State Stadium in Ąžuolynas (1925/1936)
signature_features: oval cinder running track round a grass pitch
low tiered stands with one covered wooden grandstand
tall oaks of the park behind
tricolour on a mast
locations.prompt_phrase: oval cinder running track round a grass pitch, low tiered stands with one covered wooden grandstand, tall oaks of a park behind, a yellow-green-red flag on a mast
locations.state_1981: Designed and built under Steponas Darius 1923–25, enlarged 1935–36 as the State Stadium; 1938 National Olympics. The counterfactual keeps the interwar wooden stands, not the 1969–79 Soviet concrete rebuild.

locations.name: Kaunas — University Clinics (1937–40)
signature_features: long pale rendered multi-storey wings, rows of identical windows, flat roofs
tall slender brick chimney
pines; canopied entrance
locations.prompt_phrase: long pale rendered hospital wings with rows of identical windows and flat roofs, a tall slender brick chimney rising behind, pines, a canopied entrance
locations.state_1981: Built 1937–39 (U. Cassan, E. Ouchanoff, F. Bielinskis), opened 1940; six buildings. Lithuania's own big hospital in any 1981.

locations.name: Kaunas — Romuva cinema (1940)
signature_features: narrow modernist street front
tall vertical fin rising above the roofline (sign left blank)
rounded canopy over the doors, poster frames left blank
locations.prompt_phrase: narrow pale modernist cinema front with a tall blank vertical fin rising above the roofline, a rounded canopy over the doors and empty poster frames
locations.state_1981: Opened 13 April 1940 (N. Mačiulskis); the oldest cinema still operating in Lithuania.
free_lithuania_1981_adjustments: fin and poster frames blank (no lettering)

locations.name: Kaunas — Town Hall square ("White Swan")
signature_features: wide paved old-town square
slender white town hall in the middle, 53 m tower stepping up in ever-smaller tiers to a thin spire
low two- and three-storey old houses and a church gable around
locations.prompt_phrase: wide paved old-town square with a slender white town hall standing in the middle, its tower stepping up in ever-smaller tiers to a thin spire, low old houses and a church gable round the edges
locations.state_1981: Town hall begun 1542, baroque-classicist rebuild 1771–75. A wedding palace from 1973 in reality; a municipal office in the counterfactual; nothing visible changes.
unverified_points: Kaunas trolleybus along the square edge (system from 1965; keep or drop)

locations.name: Vilnius — Philharmonic hall (1902)
signature_features: three-storey eclectic corner building with a rounded corner bay and tall arched upper windows
inside: white-and-gilt concert hall with a balcony and a wide stage
locations.prompt_phrase: inside a white-and-gilt concert hall of 1902 with a curved balcony on slender columns, tall arched windows along one side and a wide wooden stage
locations.state_1981: Built 1899–1902 as a theatre; the Great Seimas of Vilnius met there in 1905; the State Philharmonic since 1940.

locations.name: Kaunas — Konrado kavinė, Laisvės alėja
signature_features: two-storey brick house on the lime boulevard
inside: wall mirrors, small round tables, a gramophone, an upright piano
plaster statue of a girl in a niche (1938–39 refit), a glass cake case
locations.prompt_phrase: inside an interwar café on a lime boulevard: wall mirrors, small round tables, an upright piano and a gramophone, a plaster statue of a girl in a wall niche, a glass cake case, the clipped limes through the window
locations.state_1981: Café since 1862, the Konradas brothers from 1920, meeting place of the interwar writers; renamed Tulpė after the war, closed 2003. In a free 1981 it keeps its name (no lettering drawn anyway).
unverified_points: interior detail is from the 1938–39 refit as described in the source; not seen in a photograph

locations.name: Vilnius — Rasos cemetery
signature_features: steep wooded hillside of old graves
iron and stone crosses among tall trees
small chapel; candles
locations.prompt_phrase: steep wooded hillside of old graves with iron and stone crosses among tall trees, a small chapel on the slope, candles in glass lanterns
locations.state_1981: Burial place of Basanavičius (1927) and Čiurlionis (1911); in use throughout.
